_note: Trade cards (sim/caravan.gd, Yusuf's ask 2026-10-22, replacing the caravan's per-good shop). Once the needs building stands, every build phase the caravan lays out offers deals (plus trade_deals from relics and traditions), drawn without repeats from deals of the town's age or earlier (age: the first age it comes up in). Each deal is weighted by its rarity's weight (data/rarity.json; relic key trade_rarity multiplies every non-white weight by 1 + it), times need_weight when the town wants it: it brings a good the town is short of (RunState.resource_wants), it is tagged metal and a tool set of the town's age is still unbought, or it is a barter whose goods the town holds twice over. Take any deal you can pay for, each once a round. give = goods it costs (shells too); get = goods it brings, grown by growth_per_round for every round past the first (rounded down); folk = role -> how many join (needs housing); smith = every living hero's weapon gains that many tiers; relic = a random ordinary relic; hired = the folk it brings need no beds, fight this round only and leave at its end (World._finish_round); only_with = an effect key (data/paths.json): the deal is laid out every round, on top of the others, while the town has it, and never otherwise. tags: bulk (a big lot for shells), barter (goods for goods or shells), service (people or work), metal, food, folk, relic. Relic keys: trade_deals (more deals laid out), trade_rarity (rarer deals more often), barter_bonus (barter deals bring that share more).
